stories.headline: New funding adds forest restoration crews in Idaho and Wyoming
stories.body: The Nature Conservancy and the U.S. Forest Service announced a US$2.1 million commitment to expand restoration near communities in the Caribou-Targhee, Payette and Salmon-Challis national forests in Idaho and the Bridger-Teton in Wyoming.

featuredResource.title: Frictionless Forestry: Field-Level Research & Resource Needs
featuredResource.description: This PDF report examines what forestry practitioners say makes research, tools and institutional support useful in everyday work. Its findings help researchers, agencies and business advisers consider how resources can reduce effort and fit real field workflows.
